features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Age centered and scaled to roughly unit range for smooth linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous age signal suitable for linear margin computation.

features.name: education_num_normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear education signal strongly correlated with income.

features.name: hours_per_week_normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous work-intensity signal for linear models.

features.name: log_capital_gain
features.description: Log-transformed capital gain to compress heavy tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes the strongly skewed capital_gain variable for SVM margin.

features.name: log_capital_loss
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses tail of capital_loss into a usable linear feature.

features.name: capital_net_log_signed
features.description: Signed log of net capital position (gain minus loss).
features.expected_model_benefit: Single smooth capital signal capturing direction and magnitude.

features.name: hours_education_interaction
features.description: Interaction of standardized hours and education for compounding effect.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures joint effect of high education and long hours in a linear-friendly product.

features.name: age_education_interaction
features.description: Interaction of standardized age and education.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures experience-times-credential joint signal for the linear hyperplane.

features.name: prime_working_age_score
features.description: Smooth bump centered at age 45 indicating peak earning years.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a non-linearized continuous severity score the linear model can use directly.

features.name: overtime_intensity
features.description: Hours worked beyond 40 per week, clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights overtime workers via a one-sided continuous severity measure.

features.name: socioeconomic_stability_score
features.description: Semantic composite score (0-1) approximating household/employment stability based on marital_status, relationship, and workclass code patterns. Higher values indicate married-civilian, established-relationship, private/self-employed stable profiles.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain knowledge that stable household and employment configurations correlate with higher earnings into a smooth linear-friendly score.

features.name: human_capital_score
features.description: Semantic 0-1 score combining education credential level, occupation skill tier, and age-experience plateau into an interpretable human-capital index.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a single dense interpretable axis encoding skill/credential richness.
